title: `told` is compared as a moment, not as text: a couple split between Japan and the Philippines (T watch decided)
story: A couple, one shared copy. Set up Thu 10 Dec 2026, pay day: the bank holds 400,000, of which Free to spend 60,000 (typed). Pay of 300,000 on the 10th (moved earlier). Mon 14 Dec: Jun, in Tokyo, checks in at 10:00 Tokyo time: 380,000. Tess, in Manila, logs a 3,000 spend at 09:30 Manila time, which is 10:30 in Tokyo: after the check. As text, 09:30 comes before 10:00. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 380,000 (check-in, 10:00 in Tokyo) - 3,000 (the spend told 09:30 in Manila, 10:30 in Tokyo: after the check) = 377,000
asks.note: Compared as text the spend came first and was inside the check: 380,000.

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 60,000 (Free to spend at the opening) - 20,000 (the filler of Mon 14 Dec) - 3,000 (Tess's spend) = 37,000
